Following your instruction to act on hooks first, I reserved one computer (`origin-8080`) and ran the study through its worker, `racky-worker-1`. The worker's report says it touched only that one URL. The box is released; a status check shows no remaining boxes.

The worker also reported the title and status were verified, and noted
